name: com.moe.pushlibrary.providers.MoEProvider
description: Android creates this private MoEngage data provider as the app starts. The SDK uses it to store and read push inbox messages, interaction events, in-app campaigns, user attributes, and campaign records.
disableEffect: MoEngage message, campaign, and event storage can fail, and apps that rely on these SDK flows may lose inbox or in-app features.
